{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Bulgaria|Cuisine of Bulgaria]]

[[File:Za shopska salata.JPG|thumb|308x308px|Some ingredients used in the making of Shopska Salata.]]

== Ingredients==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cucumber|cucumbers]]
* 2 roasted peppers or fresh [[Cookbook:Green pepper|green bell peppers]]
* 2 spoonfuls chopped [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]]
* 2 spoonfuls chopped [[Cookbook:Red onion|red onion]] or [[Cookbook:Green Onion|green onion]] 
* ½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (225 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) white cheese ([[Cookbook:Feta Cheese|feta]]; optional)
* Some [[Cookbook:Olive|olives]] (optional)
* [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]], [[Cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]], [[Cookbook:Oil|oil]] to taste

== Procedure ==
# Cut the tomatoes, cucumbers and peppers in small pieces—cubes if possible.
# Mix well with the parsley, onion, salt, and oil.
# Serve with white cheese grated on top. Enjoy!
